phases.name: loop
phases.description: One stroke of 27 native frames at 24 fps (1.125 s, inside the 0.8-1.2 s core-loop target): the tail rises and falls through one connected hip-to-fin wave, the fin tip trails, arms scull near the chest, shoulders and bodice answer, the ponytail streams and settles. The 81-frame take holds three strokes; review picks the cleanest as the loop.
